dict.string: 開啟：遊戲的底座設定，輸出 1920×1080、內部 1600×900，需要較快的 iPad。關閉：手持 1280×720（內部 960×540）。重新啟動遊戲後生效 · on: the game's docked settings, 1920×1080 output, 1600×900 inside (for a fast iPad). Off: handheld 1280×720 (960×540 inside). Takes effect after relaunching the game

关闭时使用上面的「Full HD（底座模式）」与「帧率」两个预设；打开后本组生效，那两个预设不生效。MetalFX、画面比例、界面等设置始终生效。重启游戏后生效 · off: the two presets above decide the size and the frame rate; on: this group does, and the presets do not. MetalFX, aspect ratio and the interface apply either way. Takes effect after relaunching

dict.string: 画质模式决定显示缓冲的大小、画布要不要由 MetalFX 放大到面板，以及是否使用游戏的底座设定（1080 档）；场景分辨率只影响 3D 世界。以上设置在「使用自定义设置」打开时生效。重启游戏后生效 · the picture mode sets the drawable, whether MetalFX upscales the canvas to the panel, and whether the game runs its docked settings (the 1080 entry); the scene resolution affects the 3D world only. Both apply while "Use custom settings" is on. Takes effect after relaunching

只影响 3D 世界，与画质模式独立。GPU 开销几乎与像素数成正比（2026-10-23 实测：960x540 12.9 ms，1280x720 26.2 ms）。1600x900 是游戏本身的场景尺寸，也是 iOS 上不需要额外堆内存覆盖的最高档。大世界里 960x540 热机后会从 60 掉到 30；800x450 约 8.9 ms，代价是画面更软。重启游戏后生效 · affects the 3D world only, independent of the picture mode. GPU cost is nearly linear in pixels (measured 2026-10-23: 12.9 ms at 960x540, 26.2 ms at 1280x720). 1600x900 is the game's own scene size and the highest value iOS runs without a bigger HeapDef overlay. In heavy areas 960x540 drops from 60 to 30 once the SoC heats up; 800x450 costs about 8.9 ms at the price of a softer picture. Takes effect after relaunching
帧率上限 · Frame rate cap

array.string: 120 帧（不限速，最高到屏幕刷新率）· 120 fps (uncapped, up to the display's rate)

dict.string: 30 最省电也最稳，长时间不变；60 推荐，发热后可能临时降到 30，冷却后自行回到 60；120 不限制节奏，能跑多快跑多快，最高就是屏幕刷新率（ProMotion iPad 为 120，60 Hz 设备就是 60）。重启游戏后生效 · 30 is the coolest and holds steady over time; 60 is recommended — after the SoC heats up the game may drop to 30 for a while and return to 60 once it cools; 120 leaves the pacing to the game, up to the display's refresh rate (120 on a ProMotion iPad, 60 on a 60 Hz screen). Takes effect after relaunching

管线：场景按「场景分辨率」渲染 → 场景超分 → 画布 → 输出超分（仅自定义模式的 MetalFX 2K 档）→ 面板。两段超分都是 MetalFX 空间放大，不增加帧延迟；边缘平滑是 MetalFX 的时间抗锯齿。重启游戏后生效 · pipeline: the scene renders at the scene resolution → scene upscaling → canvas → output upscaling (custom mode's MetalFX 2K entry only) → panel. Both stages are MetalFX spatial scaling with no added latency; edge smoothing is MetalFX temporal anti-aliasing. Takes effect after relaunching

默认关闭，与 iPhone 的决定一致：游戏自带的放大已经是一道便宜的 pass，MetalFX 不增加画面收益时就不开。打开后 3D 场景由 MetalFX 放大到画布（场景 → 画布这一段），画面更锐，实测 GPU 代价不到 0.2 ms。重启游戏后生效 · off by default, as decided for the iPhone: the game's own upscale is already one cheap pass. On, MetalFX upscales the 3D scene into the canvas (the scene → canvas stage): sharper for under 0.2 ms of GPU in our measurements. Takes effect after relaunching
边缘平滑（MetalFX 时间抗锯齿）· Edge smoothing (MetalFX TAA)
对 3D 画面做时间性抗锯齿，边缘更稳；可能有轻微拖影，默认关闭。重启游戏后生效 · MetalFX temporal anti-aliasing of the 3D scene; slight ghosting is possible. Off by default; takes effect after relaunching

备份存档到文件夹 · Back up saves to a folder

默认关闭。打开后第一次启动会弹出系统文件夹选择器，选一个位置（iCloud Drive 或「我的 iPad」任意文件夹），存档会镜像到其中的「Tears of the Kingdom」文件夹；卸载 App 不会删除它，重装后首次启动自动恢复。关闭后不再备份，已选的文件夹保留 · off by default. When on, the first launch shows the system folder picker; the save is mirrored into a "Tears of the Kingdom" folder at the chosen place (iCloud Drive or anywhere in Files). Uninstalling the app keeps it, and a fresh install restores from it automatically
从文件夹导入存档 · Import a save from a folder

打开后，下次启动会让你选一个含存档的文件夹（备份文件夹也可以），确认后替换当前存档；当前存档会先备份到 App 的 Documents/save-before-import。导入完成或取消后此开关自动关闭 · when on, the next launch asks for a folder holding a save (a backup folder works too) and replaces the current one after you confirm; the current save is kept in the app's Documents/save-before-import. The switch turns itself off afterwards

開啟後把日誌寫進 App 的 Documents/log.txt（在 Mac 上讀取），會稍微影響效能；關閉時不記錄任何日誌。重新啟動遊戲後生效 · writes Documents/log.txt for reading on a Mac (slightly slower); off records nothing. Takes effect after relaunching the game
